messages.content: [Condensed record of the VX-12 doping series]
VX-12 doping series, condensed: the first batch found peak stability at 2% doping. A recalibrated sweep also measured a peak at 4%. Humidity ruled out as a factor.
Per our current valid conclusion, what doping concentration gives peak stability for VX-12? Answer with the percentage only. End your reply with the percentage alone on the last line.
